notes.title: Achievements Unlocked for Assassin's Creed Freedom Cry!
notes.content:
[h2]🔓 Achievements Unlocked! 🔓[/h2]
 

It's time to rise up and set sail once more as Steam achievements are now available for Assassin’s Creed Freedom Cry.


[i][b]Achievements will be retroactively earned for those accomplishments already completed in your journey upon launching the game.[/b][/i]
 

Jump back into the action with Adewale and start collecting those awards. 💪

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Assassin's Creed Freedom Cry
notes.content:
Assassin's Creed Freedom Cry is Now Available on Steam!

Born a slave, Adewale found freedom as a pirate aboard Edward Kenway’s ship, the Jackdaw. 15 years later, Adewale has become a trained Assassin who finds himself shipwrecked in Saint-Domingue without weapons or crew. He now has to acquire a ship and gather his own crew to free the slaves and avenge them. Over 3 hours of new single-player gameplay!

Assassin’s Creed® Freedom Cry is a standalone game and doesn't require a copy of Assassin’s Creed®IV Black Flag™.
